Integrity.//: Score-submission integrity. Mode governs the play-session tier ONLY (Off | Observe | Enforce); the absolute-range tier is always on and is what keeps int.MaxValue off a board. Observe is the default because two legitimate paths submit without a fresh session - ScoreSyncService replaying a score parked offline, and any round that outlives SessionTtlMinutes - and Enforce would silently drop exactly the scores the PWA's durable-submission design exists to protect. Read the Warning-level 'Score integrity:' lines, then flip to Enforce once they are quiet.
Integrity.//MaxCreditedSeconds: Ceiling on the elapsed time one session may vouch for, however old it really is. Without it the rate tier has an obvious hole: mint a session, wait, and the accrued wall-clock alone justifies an enormous point total.

ApplicationInsights.//: Connection string is empty by default — populated via env var APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING in deployed environments. Leave empty in local dev to disable telemetry; GET /api/diag reports the config state as applicationInsightsConfigured.

AI.//: Endpoint + deployments come from Key Vault (kv-poshared, PoMiniGames--AI--*) in deployed environments. ValidateDeploymentsOnStartup lists the account's deployments and fails Production startup on a name that is not there — the check that would have caught the gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o phantoms before players did.
AI.//Deployments: Per-game (and per-task, 'game.task') deployment routing. These are LOCAL FALLBACKS only — the Key Vault secret PoMiniGames--AI--Deployments wins when present (flat form fills gaps, never overwrites). Task routing: joker.rating scores three numbers (Phi-4-mini-instruct is the right size and ~10x cheaper than a gpt-5 deployment); joker.rewrite stays on the default because creative quality matters there. couplequiz.similarity is the chat fallback for answer scoring — cheap model by design.

TokenBudget.//: Per-identity daily token ceiling across the whole AI surface. The 'infer' rate limit shapes burst (10 req/s) but bounds no spend at all: one tab left open is ~36k calls/hour against a metered deployment.

Jev.//: TypeSafe's Jev decision model on OpenRouter, driving PoJevArena. REQUIRED by that game: with no ApiKey the arena reports 'Jev unavailable' and never invents decisions. The key is Key Vault secret PoMiniGames--Jev--ApiKey in deployed environments, or a local-only appsettings.Development.json value; never commit it. One unit decision = one call (~500 input tokens, ~$0.00002); a 3-minute 10v10 match at 1 Hz is ~3,600 calls.

PoVoxelStrike.//: Startup GLB → voxel ingestion. Paths resolve against the content root when relative. On App Service (WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=1, read-only package mount) ConvertedPath must be overridden to a writable absolute path under %HOME%\data.
